title: A Door the Size of a Valley
text: At the terminator, where the light gives out, the ground is cut. A seam runs north and south as far as the sensors reach, dead straight, its lips raised and machined. It isn't a fault. It's a join.

lines.text: "That's a door. That is a door the size of a valley."
"No lock. No hinge. No handle. It isn't a door at all, it's a lid. Whatever is under it doesn't expect to be opened from this side."

notes: Without survivors-met. With it, the-door-lid fires instead.
